therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with mild cognitive impairment due to Alzheimer's disease or mild Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in CSF Aβ1-40 and Aβ1-42 concentrations at 12 and 26 weeks

results.effect_size: CSF Aβ1-40 reductions of -31.8% to -58.9% vs +3.7% placebo at 12 weeks; CSF Aβ1-42 reductions of -34.4% to -60.7% vs +6.5% placebo at 12 weeks
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-dependent reductions in CSF Aβ1-40 and Aβ1-42 concentrations observed at 12 weeks across all LY2886721 dose groups; plasma Aβ reductions of up to -88.1% (Aβ1-40) and -78.2% (Aβ1-42) at 12 weeks
biomarker_changes: CSF Aβ1-40 percent change at 12 weeks: -31.8% (15 mg), -57.7% (35 mg), -58.9% (70 mg) vs +3.7% placebo
CSF Aβ1-42 percent change at 12 weeks: -34.4% (15 mg), -52.0% (35 mg), -60.7% (70 mg) vs +6.5% placebo
Plasma Aβ1-40 percent change at 12 weeks: -73.4% (15 mg), -80.8% (35 mg), -88.1% (70 mg) vs +1.90% placebo
Plasma Aβ1-42 percent change at 12 weeks: -63.4% (15 mg), -71.1% (35 mg), -78.2% (70 mg) vs +0.541% placebo
Plasma Aβ1-40 percent change at 26 weeks: -72.3% (15 mg), -85.0% (35 mg), -89.1% (70 mg) vs +0.944% placebo
Plasma Aβ1-42 percent change at 26 weeks: -65.1% (15 mg), -75.0% (35 mg), -80.8% (70 mg) vs +1.82% placebo
CSF Tau percent change at 12 weeks: +14.3% (15 mg), +2.6% (35 mg), +6.8% (70 mg) vs -4.4% placebo
CSF Ptau-181 percent change at 12 weeks: +0.7% (15 mg), +1.7% (35 mg), +4.3% (70 mg) vs -3.6% placebo
26-week CSF Aβ and tau data not reported due to early termination
safety_signals: Study terminated due to abnormal liver biochemical tests in some participants
Serious adverse events included Crohn's disease (35 mg arm), small intestinal obstruction (15 mg arm), and syncope (35 mg arm)

dose_info.dose_modifications: Study terminated early due to hepatotoxicity signals

context.indication: Mild cognitive impairment due to Alzheimer's disease or mild Alzheimer's disease
context.investigator_commentary: Study terminated due to abnormal liver biochemical tests in some participants.
